generated.why: rendered output of another generated template, which escapes its own props (Latte og_include returns the HTML the included template produced)
Twig include() of a generated primitive (Button/Icon/Link/Text/Box): output of an autoescaped template; inline <svg> children are generator string literals, labels are piped through |e

slot of a primitive or organism: callers pass a captured, already escaped fragment ({capture} / (string) $c_N); the builder never passes children from layout props (Fragment and Front render catalog templates with props only; Layout::clean strip_tags + escapes strings and drops __html)

slot props of internal sub-templates (section-frame, page-header, panel, …): filled only by generated organisms with captured fragments ($f_N) or og_lucide(); never a catalog block template (the gate checks it), so layout props cannot reach them

TrustedHtml ({__html}) printed by og_html (Runtime::html): a non-marker value is escaped; markers come only from DataSources — the_content of the current post as is, every other {__html} (meta, records) through wp_kses_post (DataSources::trusted); layouts cannot carry __html (Layout::untrust)
inline SVG of a bundled Lucide icon looked up by name in icons/lucide-icons.json (unknown name → circle); attributes come from the bundled JSON
